geometryVocabulary.purpose: Coarse original vector collision cell merged from adjacent occupied thumbnail-grid cells.
Circular lethal-hazard placeholder bounded from a visible saw silhouette.
Region containing breakable silhouettes whose per-piece health remains unresolved.
Region containing visibly grouped moving parts whose path and timing remain unresolved.

reconciliation.notes: The official 70+ claim establishes a lower bound rather than an exact active-pool count.

provenance.method: Vectorized the row-ordered public thumbnail onto a 5-pixel grid, calibrated 6.4 thumbnail pixels per player diameter from the 18-pixel body measurement at a 640×360 reference frame, and manually separated visible saw regions.
provenance.tolerance: Silhouette coordinates ±0.8 player diameters; global scale ±20%; motion, destruction, and hazard timing remain unknown.

unknowns: Thumbnail-to-player scale is provisional within ±20%; later controlled current-build captures must retune exact dimensions, spawns, and camera margins.
